coordinateConvention: glTF +Y up and target +Z forward. Source +X maps to target +Z with -90 degrees about glTF +Y, equivalent to Blender +Z. Originals are not rotated.
method: Actual original GLBs imported into bpy 5.2.1 and rendered in neutral Cycles lighting, 8 samples, 320x420 per panel. Rest pose only. Previous runtime model panel excludes game-added props. Frames are independently fitted to imported scene bounds; apparent screen size is not a physical-size comparison.
